properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is Assessor lot 8709022 (8,009 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the surveyed building footprint (OpenStreetMap (way 46263441, 1670 Owens St)); 100% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 57% of the lot. The Assessor secured roll gives lot 8709022 (1670 Owens St) class 'Garages (Commercial)', year built 2010, 7 stories, with a College/University exemption in the 2025 roll. Neither cited source (OSM, the Mission Bay TMA rates page) says the garage is UCSF-owned.
